text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's fall, and El Condor Pasa's friends, Special Week and Grass Wonder, have grown significantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of them put on a special event for their fans, including a concert, and then El Condor Pasa challenges the other two in the talk show afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's decided that El Condor Pasa will face off against Special Week in the Japan Cup and Grass Wonder in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All three runners are determined to deliver incredible performances for the audience.
